$comment: Title and description of every test case, shown on the dashboard. Edit them in the dashboard's test console (each save is a commit to this file) or by hand. In a description, {name} shows the value of that test data parameter (config/cases.json). The test code is not affected: steps and checks live in tests/.

description.zh-TW: 開啟首頁 → 導覽列、搜尋、排序、篩選都可以用，商品列表有商品名稱和價格
description.en: Open the home page → navigation, search, sorting and filters are usable; products with prices are listed

title.en: Return to the home page from a product page

description.zh-TW: 首頁 → 打開第 {position} 個商品（商品頁的名稱、價格與首頁一致）→ 點導覽列「Home」→ 回到首頁，商品列表與篩選區重新出現
description.en: Home → open product #{position} (its page shows the same name and price) → click "Home" → back on the home page with the product grid and filters

description.zh-TW: Categories → {category} → 標題為「Category: {category}」並列出商品
description.en: Categories → {category} → the title is "Category: {category}" and products are listed

description.zh-TW: 搜尋「{keyword}」→ 顯示搜尋字詞；筆數與網站顯示一致；每筆名稱都含「{keyword}」
description.en: Search "{keyword}" → the term is shown; the count matches the caption; every name contains "{keyword}"

description.zh-TW: 搜尋「{product}」→ 結果中有這個商品，而且有價格
description.en: Search "{product}" → the product is listed with a price

description.zh-TW: 搜尋不存在的商品「{keyword}」→ 顯示「There are no products found.」，列表為空
description.en: Search "{keyword}", which matches nothing → "There are no products found." and an empty grid

description.zh-TW: 排序選「{sort}」→ 商品依照這個順序排列
description.en: Sort by "{sort}" → the products are listed in that order

title.zh-TW: 商品詳情與搜尋結果一致
title.en: Product details match the search result

description.zh-TW: 搜尋「{keyword}」→ 從結果點「{product}」→ 商品頁名稱、價格與列表一致；數量與加入購物車可以用
description.en: Search "{keyword}" → open "{product}" from the results → name and price match; quantity and "Add to cart" are usable

title.en: Sign in with a valid account

description.zh-TW: 用本輪自動註冊的測試帳號登入 → 進入 My account，導覽列顯示使用者名稱
description.en: Sign in with the account registered for this round → "My account" and the user name in the navigation bar

title.zh-TW: 不存在的帳號無法登入
title.en: Sign in with an unknown account is rejected

description.zh-TW: 用不存在的帳號登入 → 顯示「Invalid email or password」，維持未登入
description.en: Sign in with an unknown account → "Invalid email or password"; still signed out

title.en: Add a product to the cart

description.zh-TW: 打開「{product}」，數量設為 {quantity}，點「Add to cart」→ 出現成功提示，購物車圖示數量為 {quantity}
description.en: Open "{product}", set the quantity to {quantity} and click "Add to cart" → success message; the cart badge shows {quantity}

description.zh-TW: 購物車裡的「{product}」數量從 1 改成 {quantity} → 小計 = 單價 × {quantity}，總計與購物車圖示同步更新
description.en: Change the quantity of "{product}" in the cart from 1 to {quantity} → line total = unit price × {quantity}; cart total and badge are updated

description.zh-TW: 購物車裡的「{product}」數量從 {from} 改成 {to} → 小計 = 單價 × {to}，總計與購物車圖示同步更新
description.en: Change the quantity of "{product}" in the cart from {from} to {to} → line total = unit price × {to}; cart total and badge are updated

description.zh-TW: 購物車有「{first}」和「{second}」：刪除「{first}」→ 總計重算；再刪除「{second}」→ 購物車清空
description.en: "{first}" and "{second}" in the cart: remove "{first}" → the total is recalculated; remove "{second}" → the cart is empty

description.zh-TW: 先透過 API 登入（登入表單由 TC09 驗證），再從使用者選單登出 → 「Sign in」重新出現、登入 token 已清除，也無法再進入帳戶頁（會被導回登入頁）
description.en: Signed in through the API (TC09 covers the sign-in form) → sign out from the user menu → "Sign in" is back, the stored token is cleared, and the account page redirects to sign-in

description.zh-TW: 「{product}」× {quantity} 放進購物車 → 登入 → 帳單地址（等郵遞區號自動帶入完成）→ 貨到付款 → 訂單建立成功並顯示訂單編號（不使用信用卡）
description.en: "{product}" × {quantity} in the cart → sign in → billing address (after the postcode auto-fill completes) → Cash on Delivery → the order is created and an invoice number is shown (no card data)

description.zh-TW: 首頁：Logo、搜尋標題圖示與商品圖片都有載入；導覽列、側欄標題與搜尋按鈕的文字正確 → 打開第一個商品，「Related products」標題正確（用軟性斷言，一次列出所有問題）
description.en: Home page: the logo, the search heading icon and the product images load; the navigation, sidebar headings and search button read correctly → open the first product: the "Related products" heading is correct (soft assertions list every problem in one run)

description.zh-TW: 邊界值測試：購物車裡的「{product}」數量依序改成 10、11、99 → 都能接受，總計跟著更新；改成 100 → 自動降回上限 99 並出現提示
description.en: Boundary values: change the quantity of "{product}" in the cart to 10, 11 and 99 → each is accepted and the total follows; 100 → reduced to the limit of 99 with a warning

description.zh-TW: 依使用者故事 US6100：1 KB 的 txt、pdf、jpg 都能送出；0 KB、501 KB 與 png 檔會被拒絕並說明原因；選檔視窗只列出 txt、pdf、jpg（只在 with-bugs 版本執行，正式站的上傳規則不同，會略過）
description.en: Per user story US6100: 1 KB txt, pdf and jpg files are sent; 0 KB, 501 KB and png files are refused with an error that says why; the file dialog offers only txt, pdf and jpg (with-bugs release only; skipped on production, which has a different upload rule)

description.zh-TW: 把「Price Range」的上限拉到 {max} → 列出的每個商品價格都在區間內，而且至少有一個商品
description.en: Move the "Price Range" maximum down to {max} → every listed product is priced within the range, and at least one is listed
